tasks.short: Write recreation and fitness research grant proposals

steps.what: Retrieve and check the actual funding call, application fields and institutional proposal requirements
inputs: Actual supplied funding call and institutional guidance
outputs: Checked proposal requirements and missing-call questions

steps.what: Develop the actual recreation or fitness research question, study approach, contribution and evidence-based rationale
inputs: Actual research idea and checked supplied research evidence
outputs: Teacher-authored research argument and method brief

steps.what: Build and check the actual project timetable, resource needs and budget inputs with the institution's approved costing basis
inputs: Actual institutional rates and partner commitments where supplied
outputs: Checked project, resource and budget facts with unresolved commitments labeled

steps.what: Assemble exact institutional details, supplied publication metadata, checked timetable and budget facts into the actual proposal template
inputs: Actual institution-approved profile and publication records
Checked timetable and budget facts from s3
outputs: Factual proposal skeleton and missing-field exceptions

steps.what: Draft and edit proposal narrative from the teacher's actual research argument and checked project facts
inputs: Teacher-authored research argument and method brief
Factual proposal skeleton and checked source extracts
outputs: Draft proposal narrative linked to supplied facts and evidence

loop.purpose: Express the teacher's actual research argument in the proposal's requested narrative form
loop.input: Teacher-authored argument, checked evidence and actual project facts
loop.output: Draft narrative with source pointers and missing claims marked
loop.check: Teacher checks every claim, reference, commitment and number against actual sources in s6
loop.stop: Missing evidence, unsupported partner commitment or invented reference returns to teacher; no finalization
loop.why_not_simpler: Research-argument prose needs semantic drafting; exact factual blocks are assembled deterministically in s4

steps.what: Check and correct the complete final proposal for scientific merit, source accuracy, budget consistency and actual institutional approval status
inputs: Actual call, evidence, project facts and budget sources
outputs: Final checked proposal version with actual approval status

steps.what: Save the final checked proposal version in the same institutional working-document workspace
outputs: Saved research grant proposal

tasks.design: Assemble checked factual blocks in {DOCS} from actual proposal and {SPREADSHEET} inputs, then draft only the teacher's already developed research argument. The teacher checks the complete proposal before saving it with its actual institutional approval status.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated factual assembly and first-draft narrative wording can duplicate work after research design and costing.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing document templates and bounded drafting can reuse actual facts and authored arguments.
tasks.still_hard: A worthwhile research question, credible methods, feasible commitments and funder fit.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher develops and owns the scientific proposal and its promises.

ambition.what: Reduce proposal assembly and narrative drafting without inventing research or commitments.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-4; research office approves source permissions, confidential material handling and drafting use

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: document templates can assemble supplied proposal facts and a bounded model can draft prose from a researcher-authored argument for full checking.

assumptions: The researcher supplies the actual scientific argument in s2 and checks actual budget and commitment inputs in s3; the research office supplies real institutional and call records. Missing sources remain unresolved.
Only institutionally permitted material enters the drafting tool. Confidential third-party proposals or restricted reviewer material are not assumed accessible.

This statement is proposal writing. No external submission or new approval ceremony is invented; actual institutional approval must concern this final version before any later submission in the responsible process.
s4 replaces current manual factual copying; equivalent existing template assembly earns no new gain.
Illustrative gross saving 24 per 100 task hours, upkeep 4, net 20; same-document save has no gain.
unknowns: Actual proposal-template reuse and permitted drafting inputs
research_questions: Which proposal facts are copied repeatedly despite existing institutional records?

already_counted.description: Check call requirements, develop research and budget facts, review narrative and check the complete proposal

incremental.description: Maintain factual mappings, source blocks and draft-quality checks

approvals.approved_version: Complete proposal and actual approval status checked in s6; edits require rechecking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Unmeasured grant-writing episode; research design, costing and complete final checks retained, upkeep deducted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Define the actual reading-assignment topic, learning purpose and inclusion criteria for recreation and fitness materials
inputs: Actual course outcomes and assignment purpose
outputs: Teacher-authored reading-selection criteria

steps.what: Find and check actual catalogue and publisher records relevant to the reading criteria using the institution's library search
inputs: Actual library catalogue and publisher records
outputs: Candidate records with actual identifiers and source locations

steps.what: Import actual candidate metadata into the reference manager and deduplicate exact identifiers
inputs: Actual candidate records and identifiers from s2
outputs: Draft deduplicated reference set and unresolved metadata exceptions

steps.what: Read enough of each candidate to judge suitability, verify every retained reference against its actual record and check student access
inputs: Teacher reading criteria and library-access information
outputs: Checked retained reference set with resolved metadata or excluded exceptions

steps.what: Format the checked reference set in the required bibliography style and assemble the assignment reading list
inputs: Actual required citation style and assignment template
outputs: Complete draft bibliography

steps.what: Check the complete final bibliography, every citation and access link, assignment identity and intended course group
inputs: Actual retained source records and assignment
outputs: Final checked bibliography and course destination

steps.what: Publish the final checked bibliography to the intended assignment in the LMS
inputs: Final checked bibliography and course destination
outputs: Published outside-reading bibliography

tasks.design: Use actual library search and native reference-manager import, deduplication and formatting in {OPS_SYSTEM}, then publish the checked list through {LMS}. The teacher sets the reading purpose and checks actual suitability, reference existence and student access; no model invents titles.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual metadata copying, duplicate checks and citation formatting can repeat work.
tasks.enabler_now: Library exports and reference-manager templates can perform exact metadata handling.
tasks.still_hard: Selecting worthwhile specialist reading at the right level for the assignment.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher judges the actual work's educational relevance and credibility.

ambition.what: Reduce reference handling while retaining actual reading selection and verification.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-2; library and course owners confirm subscribed-source and publication access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: library exports and reference managers can import actual records, deduplicate identifiers and format bibliographies.

assumptions: Actual catalogue and publisher records supply metadata; s2 retrieves it and s4 checks every retained reference against the real work. Missing identifiers or unresolved records remain manual or are excluded with reason.
The teacher authors selection criteria and reads actual candidate material; no free literature judgment or generated reference list is assumed.
s3 and s5 replace currently manual metadata transfer and formatting; existing equivalent reference-manager functions already in use earn no new gain.
Illustrative gross saving 39.5 per 100 task hours, upkeep 4, net 35.5; the publication click earns no saving and shared course reading selection is counted once.
unknowns: Actual manual metadata and formatting workload and existing reference-manager use
research_questions: Which bibliography fields are typed by hand despite library export support?

already_counted.description: Specify reading needs, check search results, judge and verify retained works and check the complete final list

incremental.description: Maintain metadata mappings and citation templates and inspect import exceptions

approvals.approved_version: Complete bibliography, access links and course destination checked in s6; edits require rechecking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Unmeasured bibliography episode with manual metadata copying and formatting today; actual selection and complete verification retained, upkeep deducted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Participate in campus and community events

steps.what: Read the actual event program and confirm the teacher's role, time, place and participation requirements
inputs: Actual organizer-issued event program and existing calendar entry
outputs: Understood event role and requirements

steps.what: Attend and participate in the actual campus or community event, interact with participants and contribute the agreed recreation or fitness expertise
inputs: Actual event, participants and agreed teacher role
outputs: Actual event participation and interactions

tasks.design: Keep actual event participation with the teacher. The existing program and calendar already provide the information in {DOCS} and {CALENDAR}; no additional software change is established for this task.
tasks.previous_blocker: The substantive work is actual participation rather than repeated information processing.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing organizer information already covers basic event orientation; no new saving mechanism is identified.
tasks.still_hard: Meaningful live engagement and adapting contributions to participants.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher contributes expertise and relationships through actual attendance.

ambition.what: No supported automation change for actual event participation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: actual campus and community event participation requires personal attendance and interaction; an existing program can supply orientation.

assumptions: The organizer supplies the actual program and existing calendar entry; reading it is retained in s1 and no unmeasured search reduction is claimed.

The statement establishes no event-registration transaction, attendance record, publicity report or follow-up send for this episode. If actually required, each needs a separately measured step before changing the estimate.
Illustrative effort split only; both steps remain fully retained, gross and net saving are zero and no new maintenance work is introduced.
unknowns: Whether the institution actually requires a separate event record or external event registration
research_questions: Does this participation episode require any record or send beyond the actual attendance?

incremental.description: No new system or workflow change is proposed, so there is no incremental upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: No supported new mechanism after separating existing event information from live participation; no extra administrative baseline invented.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Perform administrative duties as department head: collect and verify actual course demand, staff availability, room capacity and approved departmental planning constraints
inputs: Actual authorized staff and room availability
outputs: Checked departmental planning inputs and missing-data issues

steps.what: Compare checked demand, availability and capacity against the actual proposed departmental course-allocation plan using exact approved rules
outputs: Explicit clashes, uncovered courses and capacity exceptions

steps.what: Judge the actual staffing and course-allocation trade-offs and formulate feasible changes within departmental authority
inputs: Actual planning inputs and exception listing
outputs: Proposed departmental planning decisions

steps.what: Discuss actual allocation issues and proposed changes with affected teaching colleagues and institutional administrators
outputs: Agreed working-plan changes or unresolved matters

steps.what: Enter and check the actual agreed working-plan changes using existing course and staff identifiers and review the complete final version
inputs: Existing checked course and staff identifiers
outputs: Final checked departmental working plan

steps.what: Save the final checked departmental working plan in the same planning workbook
outputs: Saved departmental working plan

tasks.design: Configure exact capacity and availability checks and linked course fields in {SPREADSHEET} using actual {OPS_SYSTEM} and {HCM} planning inputs. For this department-head course-allocation episode, the head retains trade-off decisions, colleague consultation and the complete final working-plan check.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual clash checking and repeated course and staff entry can add administrative work.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing planning tables can apply explicit constraints and reuse actual identifiers.
tasks.still_hard: Fair allocation, competing priorities, feasibility and actual institutional authority.
tasks.human_edge: The department head weighs the educational and personnel consequences and negotiates workable decisions.

ambition.what: Reduce exact comparisons and repeated fields in actual departmental course planning.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-4; registry, personnel and timetable owners authorize planning data and staff-related access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: planning spreadsheets can compare explicit capacity and availability rules and reuse course and staff identifiers.

assumptions: This is one actual department-head administrative workflow, course allocation, rather than an invented universal administrative baseline. Other duties need their own observed workflow before aggregating savings.

Registry, personnel and timetable owners supply actual records; s1 counts receipt, verification and missing-input handling. Existing proposed allocations are actual working-plan inputs, not generated for free.
The checks surface exact conflicts only; they do not rank staff, infer performance or make allocations. Missing constraints stop the affected check for manual resolution.

The saved output is the actual departmental working plan, not a hidden staffing notification or institution-wide release. Any later formal approval concerns this final version in the actual responsible process.
Illustrative gross saving 23.8 per 100 task hours, upkeep 3, net 20.8; existing equivalent checks earn no new gain and same-workbook saving earns none.
unknowns: Actual department-head duty mix and existing course-planning automation
research_questions: Which course-allocation capacity and availability checks are manual today?

already_counted.description: Verify planning inputs and enter and check actual agreed working-plan changes

incremental.description: Maintain approved planning constraints and identifier mappings

approvals.approved_version: Complete departmental working plan checked in s5; changes require rechecking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Unmeasured departmental course-planning episode with manual exact comparisons today; source capture, judgments, discussion and final checks retained, upkeep deducted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: Use existing research-office, library and departmental planning records with their actual owners.
skills_to_grow: Verify bibliography records and student access
Check complete final documents before release
role.ambitious_version: A recreation and fitness teacher who handles proposal facts, references and departmental planning with less repeated entry while retaining research judgment, teaching priorities and real community participation.

job.title: Recreation and Fitness Studies Teachers, Postsecondary
